Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental conceptual error in physics/chemistry by incorrectly defining the mass number of an atom. It stated that "The mass number of an atom is the sum of protons and electrons," which is false. The mass number is the sum of protons and neutrons. Additionally, it incorrectly calculated the sum as 12 (6 protons + 6 electrons) instead of the correct sum of protons and neutrons (6 + 7 = 13). This led to selecting the wrong option (C) 12 instead of the correct answer (C) 13, despite the option label being the same in the prompt's context (though the value 13 is the correct mass). The error stems from a misapplication of domain-specific knowledge regarding atomic structure without verification.
